sourceNotes: All 16 paper pages and marking-scheme pages 1–28 visually inspected independently; no tasks on the extra-work pages.
Q1(a) six classifications and Q6(a)(ii), Q7(a) complete tables are holistic marked tasks.
Q6(b)(i,ii) share 15C and Q7(e,f) share 5C: preserve both required prompts in each card.
Q1(c)(ii) is mislabelled (d)(ii) in the summary; paper, model and detailed marking notes agree on (c)(ii).
Only Q3(a), Q3(b) and Q5(b) have published starred full-credit-minus-one provision.

cards.stem: Peter had to calculate (132.068 − 63.142)/4.82. He estimated the answer first, then got 118.968 on his calculator. His estimate showed this could not be correct.
